name: sunset-off-work
description: 太阳下班 — a Remotion recreation of an animated short: a plane tows the setting sun away on a swing.

scripts.render: remotion render Sunset30fps out/sunset-off-work.mp4 --codec h264 --pixel-format yuv420p
scripts.render:alpha: remotion render Sunset30fps out/sunset-off-work.mov --codec prores --prores-profile 4444 --pixel-format yuva444p10le --image-format png
